extra.reason: Resolved via AskUserQuestion: Postgres container in CI.

P1 server data layer done: node-postgres + drizzle behind createServerFn, drizzle-kit migrations replacing the browser migrator, single-user/no-auth. Plus schemas/services/api restructure, drizzle-zod validators, t3-env. Verified: typecheck/lint/49 tests/build green, client bundle free of server code, db:migrate + schema creation smoke-tested against real Postgres. Full UI round-trip tracked as Playwright e2e follow-up.

Playwright e2e set up: dedicated container (testcontainers, :5440) + dev server (:3100) isolated from dev, POM + auto db-reset fixtures, @smoke tag + test:e2e/test:e2e:smoke scripts, career-create round-trip with DB-binding + reload-persists assertions. Review cycle applied workers:1, reuseExistingServer:false, dynamic truncate, container-leak guard. Verified: smoke passes, typecheck/lint green.
Decided: email-bound invites (plugin default, no fork). Small known audience, leaks of email-bound codes are harmless, no fork to maintain. Recorded in decision 0013.

Structured pino logger delivered: src/lib/logger.ts (prod JSON / dev pino-pretty tree-shaken from prod bundle, redact for secret fields, LOG_LEVEL from process.env with allow-list validation + warn-on-invalid). db/client pool-error handler now logs via pino's {err} serializer (captures error.code) instead of console.error. resolveLevel unit-tested. Design item (3) server-fn boundary logging re-scoped to gf-fwi.13 (prod-gated). Reviewed 2 iterations (codex + 3 agents clean); 53 tests + typecheck/lint/build green.

Error-logging request middleware delivered: src/start.ts (Start instance + global errorLogger request middleware logging THROWN server-fn/router errors via dynamically-imported pino then rethrow; CSRF re-added since defining start.ts disables Start's auto server-fn CSRF). handle-request-error.ts (log-and-rethrow helper, logger injected for client-safety) + is-loggable-error.ts (skips redirect/notFound control flow + sub-5xx Responses), both unit-tested. 5xx-Response-RESULT logging deferred to gf-fwi.12 (owns it, trigger note added). Reviewed 2 iterations (codex + 5 agents, all converged); 58 tests + typecheck/lint/build green; client bundle verified pino-free.

Wide-events canonical-log-line middleware delivered: one structured 'request' line per request (reqId from cf-ray/x-request-id/uuid, pino child, method/path/handlerType/fn/status/durationMs + ALS-accumulated fields). emitRequestLog self-guarding (logging never changes request outcome); runInstrumented lifecycle extracted + unit-tested; request-context ALS (addRequestFields/getRequestLog). Owns 5xx-response logging (gf-fwi.13 gap). Replaced handle-request-error. Reviewed 2 iterations + post-loop + extraction re-review (codex + agents, all clean); 72 tests + build green, client bundle clean; smoke-verified end-to-end (router GET / -> one INFO line). Follow-ups: gf-fwi.14, gf-fwi.15.

Auth core delivered + reviewed (3 loop iterations + delta pass, all gates green). Better Auth /minimal + admin + tanstackStartCookies + cookieCache on a catch-all route (static import + server-only marker), 4 auth tables + migration, env hardening, auth client, dev compose + scripts, schema integration test. Live sign-up/session smoke + 35/35 integration green.

Email transport landed (sendEmail + planEmailTransport branching: dev log / Cloudflare SMTP / SMTP_URL fallback, env vars, unit tests). React Email template rendering deferred to gf-fwi.2.5, where the verification/reset call sites give templates something to render into; note recorded on 2.5.

Invite-gated registration landed: better-auth-invitation-only before-signup gate, DB-backed inviteStore over invite_pending (SHA-256-hashed keys, sweep-on-set), invitation table + migration 0002, first-user-admin bootstrap via enabled-as-function gate, inviteOnlyClient, resetDb TRUNCATE, 18 integration tests. Reviewed via review-cycle (2 iters) + pr-review-toolkit (5 agents) + codex; all findings fixed (fail-open hardening, key hashing, footgun docs). Bootstrap-race hardening deferred to gf-fwi.2.7. Gates green.

Wired email verification + password reset to the transport: React Email templates (config-driven, px-safe) rendered via @react-email render+toPlainText; sendVerificationEmail/sendResetPassword callbacks await the send; boot-time assertEmailTransportConfigured guards the Better-Auth-swallows-rejections case; reset email links to app /reset-password?token= (page in gf-fwi.2.6). Deferred: gf-1xo (SMTP verify at boot). 8 new tests; full gate green.
Stage 3'-b complete: browser UI auth e2e (sign-up/login/forgot/reset via real forms, data-hydrated marker) + immediate session revocation (cookieCache disabled), reviewed and green
Sign-out control added: header SignOutButton gated to the _app subtree; signs out, invalidates the router, returns to /login. e2e drives the real control. Failed-sign-out feedback deferred to gf-vy9.
Toast system added: Intent UI sonner Toaster (themed via next-themes) mounted in root Providers; shared jsdom matchMedia stub + render test. Unblocks gf-vy9.

Client error-feedback layer shipped (hybrid). Isomorphic logger (pino browser:{asObject:true} + import.meta.env.SSR guard; client level via VITE_LOG_LEVEL; redact list preserved server-side, browser build can't redact so logError only takes the caught error; logError never throws). logError(cause,message) wired into the 4 auth-form catches (log + keep inline NETWORK_ERROR_MESSAGE, nav still blocked), the sign-out button (toasts SIGN_OUT_FAILED_MESSAGE on failure), and RootError (extracted to src/components/root-error.tsx; curated UNEXPECTED_ERROR_MESSAGE instead of raw error.message — INFO-DISCLOSURE fix; logs on SSR render + client effect). Browser logger is DEV-CONSOLE ergonomics only; prod client+server error sink is Sentry, deferred to gf-yru. /api/log and a logging server fn explicitly rejected. Reviewed 2 iterations; typecheck/lint/unit 95/integration 62/e2e 8/build+leak grep all green.

Wired Sentry via option B: captureException in the logError seam (PROD-gated, client+server), not pinoIntegration. Added t3-env client/server split (env/{client,server}.ts) with build-enforced markers keeping server var names out of the client bundle; shared scrubSentryPayload (beforeSend+beforeSendLog) mirrors the pino redact list via a single SECRET_KEYS source of truth; server.ts wraps the entry with wrapFetchWithSentry (forwarding request opts); start.ts adds Sentry request/function middleware; router.tsx adds browser tracing; sourcemaps gated on SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN. Follow-up gf-z0b for source-map upload + release tagging.

Hardened first-admin bootstrap against the concurrent-signup TOCTOU race via env-designated admin (INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL). Only the designated email may register on a fresh DB and becomes admin; better-auth lowercases email pre-insert + the UNIQUE email column is the single-winner guard, so concurrent designated signups can't both claim admin (double-admin race CLOSED). Non-designated signups during the bootstrap window are rejected with the same INVITE_REQUIRED surface as the closed gate (no bootstrap-state leak); unset INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL fails closed. Gate enabled:adminExists (open only until first admin). Accepted residual (user chose env-designated over seed+always-on-gate): a sub-ms non-privileged gate-bypass window. Verified: 33 auth integration tests (incl. concurrent-winner, case-insensitive both sides, reopen-on-removal, fail-closed-undesignated) + 8 e2e (env->gate path end-to-end). Docs 0009/0013/spec-0001 updated. Follow-up gf-utf: constrain role column / 'admin' magic string.

Typed the user.role column to the 'user'|'admin' domain via drizzle text({ enum: USER_ROLES }) — TS-only narrowing (verified no migration; column stays plain text so the admin plugin's comma-separated multi-role writes aren't rejected), making a typo'd role filter/grant a compile error. Extracted ADMIN_ROLE const used by the bootstrap probe + grant (src/lib/auth/server.ts); test helper insertUser tightened to UserRole|null. No behavior change (33 auth integration + 138 unit pass). Test 'admin' literals kept as test-as-spec (now typo-safe via the column type). Follow-up gf-thb: validate runtime /admin/set-role writes (no consumer yet; out of scope).

Built a public landing at / (light what-this-is + Sign in / Create account CTAs, inlined in src/routes/_public/index.tsx). Chose the landing-at-/ seam: the squad app moved behind the _app guard to /squad (src/routes/_app/squad.tsx, moved verbatim from the deleted _app/index.tsx); an authenticated visitor to / is redirected to /squad (beforeLoad), so login/signup which navigate to / land in the app. SignOutButton now renders on session presence (authClient.useSession) rather than _app route match. Removed redundant @vitest-environment jsdom directives from unit component tests (unit project already defaults to jsdom). Verified: typecheck/lint/unit-138/e2e-8/build green; full review cycle clean (code-reviewer, pr-test, codex, maintainability, spec-conformance, cleanup). Follow-ups: gf-4m1 (errors/not-found components), gf-t5m (layouts + move SignOutButton into the header).

Subdivided src/lib by concern: lib/logging/ (logger, is-loggable-error, request-log, request-context + tests), lib/utils/ (number, primitive/cx); use-mounted -> src/hooks/; email/ + messages.ts stay flat. cx confirmed as the React-Aria render-prop className composer (kept — not replaceable by tailwind-variants; placed in lib/utils as a utility, NOT components/, which is components-only). All 11 files pure renames, ~28 importers + start.ts dynamic imports repointed, architecture.md (lib-by-concern) + styling.md (cx path) updated. Reviewed by 6 agents (all clean, 1 doc-path fix) + gates green: typecheck/lint/unit 139/integration 68/build.

Auth is now a feature module (Stage A) with deduped forms (Stage B). Stage A (43730f6): relocated src/lib/auth -> src/modules/auth (lib singletons, api/get-session, per-form schemas/, messages, use-sign-out hook), retired lib/auth, repointed ~11 consumers. Stage B: extracted useAuthSubmit (429/network/per-page-code error taxonomy on a single discriminated AuthSubmitErrors union; folded the duplicate SignUpFormError) + AuthCard/AuthLinks; the four _auth forms are distinct per-page components behind thin route shells wiring route-typed context into router-agnostic forms (forgot's success card + reset's no-token card stay local); the curated-copy invariant lives in one tested hook. Reviewed across 3 cycles (codex + code-reviewer + pr-test + silent-failure + type-design + maintainability + spec-conformance), all clean; gates green: typecheck/lint/unit 144/integration 68/e2e 8/build/leak. One refinement: a rate-limited sign-up now shows the rate-limit message. Unblocks gf-fwi.17/.19/.20/gf-4m1/gf-t5m.

Implemented + reviewed: server-only markers on 6 modules, api split to one-fn-per-file with static imports, start.ts static conversion (verified clean), eslint exemptions dropped. Gates green: typecheck/lint/unit144/integration68/e2e8/build + client-bundle leak grep. Findings recorded in notes; gf-9g6 filed for vi.mock DRY.

Collapsed the duplicated per-fn vi.mock factories behind a vi.hoisted mockApi helper (6 player + 2 career); single mock file left untouched. Reviewed by 4 agents (codex/code-reviewer/pr-test-analyzer/type-design): behavior byte-for-byte equivalent, integration 68 green. Record<string,unknown> return kept per user decision.

Progressive email verification shipped: dismissable banner (request-link + cooldown + verified toast), VerifiedGate feature-gating of the squad writes, bootstrap-admin auto-verify, and a server rate-limit on the verification-send path. requireEmailVerification stays OFF per the user-confirmed pivot. Reviewed (2 iterations), all gates green (unit 160/integration 70/e2e 8), verified live in-browser. Server-side mutation enforcement -> gf-fwi.3; 5 follow-ups filed.

All 7 children resolved (auth core, invite gate, transport, verification/reset flows, auth UI, admin-bootstrap race hardening); deps gf-fwi.10 + gf-fwi.1 closed. Remaining verification-UX items are separately-tracked P3 follow-ups, not in this bead's acceptance.

Added a Better Auth before-hook on /send-verification-email that requires a session and overwrites the email with the session user's, ignoring the client param. Closes the arbitrary-email inbox-bombing vector at the endpoint (not just the UI call). Unauth→401. Integration tests updated: param-ignored, unauth-rejected, rate-limit still enforced.

Verification links (signup + resend) now redirect to /squad?verified=1 via a self-built URL in server.ts sendVerificationEmail (single source of truth, mirrors the reset flow). Squad route validates the param, fires the 'Email verified' toast once (ref-guarded), and strips it via replace navigate. Banner's now-dead callbackURL param removed. Integration test locks the callbackURL.

Shipped the /account settings page: header link (signed-in only), change-password (gf-3x4), and verified-only change-email via Better Auth two-step old-address confirmation. NB the bead's original DESIGN/Scope lines were superseded — change-email is verified-only (not unverified), the backend landed here (not gf-3aw), and there's no session refetch (the change is deferred to the new address's confirmation). Browser-verified end-to-end.

Built the authenticated change-password form: changePassword({ currentPassword, newPassword, revokeOtherSessions }) with a 'sign out other devices' checkbox (default off — the user-choice counterpart to the forced reset revoke). Wrong current password routes to the field via changePasswordFormError. Lives on the gf-4wj /account page. Browser-verified (wrong-password error + happy path).

OBVIATED by the verified-only change-email design. Under email-bound invites the unverified-typo premise is unreachable (signup enforces EMAIL_MISMATCH) AND allowing unverified change-email is an invite bypass. Change-email is now verified-users-only with old-address confirmation (gf-4wj); there is no separate unverified escape hatch to build.

e2e for the unverified-invitee path: banner + create-career gate (aria-disabled, keyboard-activate toast) + verify-email redirect round-trip (mints the HS256 token Better Auth never persists, drives the real endpoint, asserts ?verified=1 survived → toast → unlock). create-career is the representative gate; add-player/record-snapshot stay on component tests. Real-delivery (Mailpit) lane tracked in gf-4o8.
